status: proposed experiment contract; not a newly approved rendering specification
goal: same recognizable character, aesthetic, expression and visual language; not exact source-pixel replication
invariants: distinctive tied brown hair, fringe and pale tie
recognizable face and near/far eye relationship
olive jacket, light shirt, wide jeans, pale shoes and cream tote where visible
material color relationships, selective contours and intentional shading clusters
allowed_variation: fewer secondary strands/folds/texture at a smaller grid
minor deliberate cluster changes preserving identity and style
palette_policy: provisional; do not inherit illustrative 32-color test as a restriction
reference_supply: multiple generated/supplied views, poses, expressions and sheets allowed when useful
